turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, good to have you here. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Our hamster escaped last night. The cage door was open. Help.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Don't worry, they're usually still in the house. Close doors to keep him in one area and check behind sofas and under the fridge.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hamsters come out at night. Put small piles of food in a few rooms and see which one gets eaten.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: You can also put a bit of flour around the food, so you'll see little footprints showing where he's going.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And then how do I catch him?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Put a deep bucket with some bedding and a treat at the bottom, with a ramp up to it. He'll climb in and can't get back out.
